notes: Stories defined for Brain Lock TTL and Deadlock Recovery with clear separation of concerns.

stories.title: Lock Schema with TTL and Ownership Metadata
stories.description: Define the Brain lock data model including lock_id, owner_id, acquired_at, ttl_seconds, and status fields to support expiration and recovery logic.

stories.title: TTL Enforcement and Expiration Logic
stories.description: Implement core logic to evaluate lock age against TTL and automatically mark locks as expired when ttl_seconds is exceeded.

stories.title: Deadlock Detection and Recovery Execution
stories.description: Implement detection of stuck execution states and enable forced lock release and safe reacquisition to recover Brain loop processing.

stories.title: Lock Lifecycle Integration with Brain Runner
stories.description: Integrate lock acquisition, TTL checks, and recovery logic into the Brain runner execution loop to ensure safe concurrent processing.

stories.title: Unit and Integration Tests for Lock TTL and Recovery
stories.description: Create test suite covering lock expiration, concurrent acquisition attempts, deadlock scenarios, and recovery behavior.

per_feature.mitigation: Use conservative TTL defaults and ensure idempotent lock release logic.
